violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: OBSERVED NO THERMOMETER IN 1-DOOR PEPSI COOLER AND NO THERMOMETER FOR BOTH SIDES OF THE SERVICE LINES.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PLEASE ENSURE A UNIT THERMOMETER IS ADDED TO ALL COLD HOLDING UNITS.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED FRONT HANDWASHING SINK MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 76F. OBSERVED WOMEN’S RESTROOM HANDWASHING SINK MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 71F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINK CAN MEET 100F AT A MINIMUM BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: OBSERVED BOTH HANDWASHING SINKS IN BACK KITCHEN MISSING APPROPRIATE SIGNAGE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS WILL EMAIL PIC COPIES OF HANDWASHING POSTERS THAT MAY BE POSTED (OR ESTABLISHMENT MAY POST THEIR OWN). PLEASE POST AT BOTH HANDWASHING SINKS AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Water Pressure Meets Facility Demands
violations.observation: Water under insufficient pressure was found to serve the following equipment: HANDWASHING SINK AT FRONT KITCHEN (BEHIND SERVICE LINE) AND THE WOMEN’S RESTROOM.
violations.corrective_action: Water under pressure shall be provided to all fixtures, equipment, and nonfood equipment that are required to use water. PLEASE ENSURE PRESSURE FOR HANDWASHING SINKS IS REPAIRED BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.
